public.hero.intro: Mecropolis ihlanganisa ama-heat units (GDD) kusukela ekuhlanyeleni, isebenzisa amazinga okutshisa agcinwe yi-Open-Meteo. Isizini ngayinye eWestern Cape idluliselwa esigabeni esilandelayo nxa inani selifike lapho isilimo esidinga khona.

public.how.title: Kusukela ekuhlanyeleni kusiya esigabeni
public.how.lead: Isigaba sijayele ukufakwa ngesandla, ngakho silandela ukuvuselelwa kokucina kuphela. Lapha sibalwa ngesimo sezulu esigciniweyo, njalo konke ukutshintsha kugcina ubufakazi.
public.step.1.title: Gcina lokho umlimi akwaziyo
public.step.1.body: Amapulazi, amasimu, izilimo lamalanga okuhlanyela kugcinwa ku-Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Thatha isimo sezulu esenzakeleyo
public.step.2.body: Amazinga okutshisa ansuku zonke endaweni yesimu avela kudatha endala ye-Open-Meteo, kusukela ekuhlanyeleni kuze kube lamuhla.
public.step.3.title: Hlanganisa ama-heat units
public.step.3.body: Ama-heat units (GDD) ayahlanganiswa ngemodeli yesilimo. Nxa inani selifike lapho okumele lifike khona, uhlelo ludlulisela isizini esigabeni esilandelayo njalo lugcine isizatho.
public.models.title: Amamodeli ezilimo asetshenziswayo
public.models.lead: Ama-heat units adingekayo ukuze isilimo sivuthwe ngokutshisa. Amanani la abhalwe ngesandla njalo awakabi lemithombo.
public.live.title: Isimo epulazini lokubonisa eSwartland
public.live.lead: Izilinganiso zivela emithonjeni yomphakathi, zivuselelwa ngemizuzu engu-30.
public.yields.title: Izilinganiso zesivuno ezikhitshiweyo
public.honesty.title: Idatha iphathwa njani
public.honesty.1.title: Isivuno sifakwa ngumsebenzisi
public.honesty.1.body: Umlimi engakafaki isivuno, i-app itshengisa ukuthi “Akukabhalwa”.
public.honesty.2.title: Izilinganiso zigcinwa zodwa
public.honesty.2.body: Izibalo zesigaba leselizwe zigcinwa emibhalweni yazo, lomthombo leyunithi. Aziqathaniswa lesivuno sensimu.
public.honesty.3.title: Imibhalo yezinambuzane ngeyesigaba
public.honesty.3.body: Imibhalo ye-GBIF itshengisa lapho ezabonwa khona phakathi kuka-100 km, kanye lebanga.
public.honesty.4.title: Umumo womkhathi ngowakhathesi
public.honesty.4.body: Amazinga okutshisa athathwa kungobo yomlando ye-Open-Meteo ngesikhathi ecelwa.
public.open.title: Vula isizini
public.open.body: Ngena ebhodini ledemo ubone ijika le-GDD lesizini lobufakazi besigaba sayo.
public.live.unavailable: Idatha ye-{source} ayitholakali khathesi ({reason}). Akulalutho olufakwa endaweni yayo.
public.live.weatherChart: Amazinga okutshisa aphansi laphezulu kanye lezulu ngosuku ngesikhathi sesibikezelo
public.live.pestsLead: Imibhalo elendawo phakathi kuka-{radius} km yepulazi.
public.yield.lead: Lezi inhlobo ezintathu zilinganisa izinto ezitshiyeneyo emazingeni atshiyeneyo. Azinakuqathaniswa zodwa loba lensimu.
public.about.title: Mayelana
public.about.heading: Mayelana leMecropolis
public.about.lead: IMecropolis ilandelela amasimu lezilimo zepulazi laseWestern Cape.
public.about.why.title: Yenzelwani
public.about.why.body: Izigaba zamasimu ziyaphelelwa yisikhathi, lezivuno zifakwe ngokukhunjulwa. IMecropolis ibala isigaba ngomumo womkhathi obhaliweyo. Inombolo ngayinye ivela kumlimi loba emthonjeni womphakathi oqanjiweyo.
public.about.design.title: Indlela eyakhiwe ngayo
public.about.design.1.body: Ama-heat units (GDD) aqoqwa kusukela ngosuku lokuhlanyela kusetshenziswa ingobo yomlando ye-Open-Meteo. Ukutshintsha ngakunye kwesigaba kugcina ubufakazi: usuku okuqale ngalo, inani le-GDD lalokho elibalwe ngakho.
public.about.design.2.body: Isigaba esilandela esangaphambi kokuvuna sibizwa ngokuthi ukuvuthwa ngokutshisa ngoba akulalanga lokuvuna elibhaliweyo.
public.about.design.4.body: Zigcinwa emibhalweni yazo lomthombo, iyunithi lelayisensi.
public.about.stack.title: Ubuchwepheshe
public.about.stack.body: I-app yekhasi elilodwa ye-Vite le-React 19 iku-Cloudflare Pages. Isiphequluli sifunda idatha yomphakathi ye-Sanity ngqo nge-GROQ langokulalela ngesikhathi esisodwa. Okubhalwayo ledatha elamakhiye kudlula ku-Cloudflare Pages Functions, ehlola ikhukhi yeseshini esayiniweyo. I-Zod ihlola lapho idatha ingena laphuma khona, i-Vitest ngeyokuhlola, i-Tailwind 4 ngeyokulungisa ukubukeka.
public.about.limits.title: Okusasilelayo
public.about.limits.1: Amanani emodeli yesilimo (izinga lokutshisa eliyisisekelo, ama-heat units okuhluma lokuvuthwa) abhalwe ngesandla njalo awakabi lemithombo.
public.about.limits.2: Isilinganiso se-lupin sivela ku-HarvestStat seminyaka ka-2000 kusiya ku-2007 kuphela, njalo ukuqaliswa kwedatha akutholanga mibhalo yesilinganiso se-lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Idatha yezinambuzane yimibhalo ye-GBIF eseduze lepulazi. Itshengisa lapho uhlobo oluthile olwabhalwa khona eduze lepulazi.
public.about.limits.4: Idemo ilokungena okukodwa okwabelwanwayo lomkhawulo wezicelo ogcinwa enkumbulweni. Ukungena kufihla amakhasi ebhodi kodwa akuvikeli idatha: wonke umuntu angayifunda. Kodwa kuvikela konke okubhalwayo.

docs.lead: Indlela yokusebenzisa iMecropolis kukhompyutha yakho lalokho okwenziwa zindawo zayo zokuxhumana.
docs.setup.title: Ukulungisa
docs.setup.serves: I-app isebenza ku-{0}, idlulisele u-{1} kuma-Pages Functions aku-{2}. Isiphequluli sifunda izilungiselelo ngemojuli eyodwa, ama-Functions ahlole ezawo; akukho okuqalayo nxa kukhona okungekho.

docs.stages.title: Ukuhamba kwezigaba
docs.stages.guards: Ukudlulela ngakunye kulombandela. Esokuhlanyela sidinga usuku lokuhlanyela lesilimo; esokukhula sidinga umkhawulo wama-degree days wokuhluma; esangaphambi kokuvuna sidinga u-90% womkhawulo wokuvuthwa; ukuvuthwa ngokutshisa kudinga ukufika emkhawulweni wokuvuthwa; ukuhlola kudinga umumo womkhathi wesizini ogciniweyo lesilinganiso esitholakeleyo. Imibandela ye-GDD idinga ledatha yokutshisa okungenani ku-90% wesikhathi, njalo ukudlulela ngosuku oluzayo kuyavinjwa.
docs.endpoints.title: Izindawo zokuxhumana
docs.endpoints.errors: Amaphutha abuyisa {0}. Ukubhala kudinga lesicelo esivela endaweni efanayo.
docs.ep.advance: Hambisa isizini phambili (iseshini idinga i-seasonId), loba ngekhodi yokungena uhambise wonke amasizini phambili nge-GDD
docs.ep.scenario: Bala i-GDD yokuthi kungenzekani; akulalutho olugcinwayo
docs.ep.landing: Umumo womkhathi, umhlabathi, izilokazane lesivuno sepulazi lokubonisa
docs.ep.conditions: Umumo womkhathi, umhlabathi lezilokazane zepulazi elilodwa
docs.seed.title: Ukufaka idatha yokuqala
docs.seed.body: {0} ifaka ipulazi lokubonisa, amasimu, izilimo lezikhathi zokulima kudatha ekhethiweyo, ibuye ivumelanise lezilinganiso zesigaba. Isusa ipulazi, amasimu lezilimo ezikhona, ngakho yisebenzise kuphela kudatha engeyakho.
guide.title: Indlela yokusebenzisa i-Mecropolis
guide.lead: Umhlahlandlela omfitshane ngamazwi alula. Uchaza ukuthi uhlelo lolu lwenzelwani, ngobani, lokuthi ingxenye ngayinye yenzani.
guide.what.title: Iyini i-Mecropolis
guide.what.p1: I-Mecropolis ilandelela amasimu lezilimo epulazini. Ibala ukuthi isilimo sesikhule safika ngaphi ngokuhlanganisa ukutshisa esikuthole selokhu sihlanyelwe. Iphinda itshengise umumo womkhathi, umhlabathi lezilokazane eziseduze lepulazi lakho endaweni eyodwa.
guide.what.p2: Yenzelwa amapulazi aseWestern Cape eSouth Africa, kodwa indlela le isebenza kuloba yiliphi ipulazi, isigaba lesikhathi sokulima.
guide.who.title: Yenzelwe bani
guide.who.p1: Yenzelwe umuntu onakekela amasimu, njengomlimi, umphathi wepulazi kumbe umeluleki wabo.
guide.who.p2: Akudingeki wazi ngamakhompyutha kumbe isayensi yomkhathi. Nxa usenelisa ukuvula iwebhusayithi, ungayisebenzisa i-Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Kungani ungayisebenzisa
guide.why.1: Ungabona masinyane ukuthi yiziphi izilimo ezisanda kuhlanyelwa, ezikhulayo lezisizavunwa.
guide.why.2: Akudingeki ulungise insimu ngayinye ngesandla. Uhlelo luzihambisela isilimo phambili nxa umumo womkhathi utshengisa ukuthi sekuyisikhathi.
guide.why.3: Luyakuxwayisa ngesithwathwa lokutshisa okuzayo ensukwini ezilandelayo, langezilokazane ezibonwe eduze lepulazi lakho.
guide.why.4: Konke okubhalwe ngensimu, njengokufafaza, isilokazane osibonileyo kumbe umbhalo, kugcinwa ndawonye losuku lwakho ukuze ukubone futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
guide.why.5: Inombolo ngayinye itshengisa lapho evela khona ukuze wazi ongakwethemba.
guide.heat.title: Uhlelo lwazi njani ukuthi isilimo sesifike ngaphi
guide.heat.p1: Izilimo zikhula masinyane nxa kutshisa, zikhule kancane nxa kuqanda. I-Mecropolis ibala ukutshisa kwelanga ngalinye ngamayunithi okutshisa, abezesayensi abawabiza ngokuthi growing degree days kumbe GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Ilanga ngalinye ithatha isilinganiso esiphakathi kokutshisa okuphezulu lokuphansi, ibisusa izinga lapho isilimo esima ukukhula khona. Okusalayo ngamayunithi okutshisa alelolanga. Ilanga eliqandayo kalengezi lutho.
guide.heat.p3: Isilimo ngasinye sidinga inani elithile lamayunithi okutshisa singakavuthwa. Nxa inani eliqoqwe selokhu sihlanyelwe selisondela kulelo nani, isilimo sidlulela esigabeni esilandelayo.
guide.heat.p4: Amazinga okutshisa avela ku-Open-Meteo, isevisi yomkhathi yamahhala egcina umumo womkhathi wazo zonke indawo emhlabeni.
guide.stages.title: Izigaba eziyisithupha
guide.stages.intro: Isilimo ngasinye ensimini ngayinye sidlula kulezi zigaba ngokulandelana.
guide.stages.planning: Isikhathi sokulima sesilungisiwe, kodwa isilimo asikahlanyelwa.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Isilimo sesiqoqe ukutshisa okunengi esikudingayo, ngakho sekuyisikhathi sokulungiselela ukuvuna.
guide.stages.harvested: Isilimo sesiqoqe konke ukutshisa esikudingayo, ngakho kufanele sesivuthiwe. Nguwe kuphela ongatsho ukuthi sivuniwe sibili, yikho uhlelo luthi sesivuthwe ngokutshisa.
guide.stages.review: Isikhathi sokulima sesiphelile, usungahlola ukuthi sihambe njani.
guide.stages.p2: Uhlelo luhlola isilimo ngasinye ebusuku njalo nxa umuntu efaka akubonileyo kumbe umsebenzi awenzileyo. Ungacindezela njalo u-Reconcile now kusikhathi sokulima ukuze luhlole khonapho.
guide.start.title: Ukuqalisa
guide.start.1: Vula ikhasi lokuqala. Ungabona imephu yomkhathi, umhlabathi, izilokazane lezivuno zepulazi lokubonisa ungakangeni.
guide.start.2: Cindezela u-Sign in phezulu, usebenzise imininingwane ye-akhawunti yokubonisa oyiphiweyo.
guide.start.3: Khetha ipulazi. Lokhu kuvula ikhasi elikhulu lalelo pulazi.
guide.start.4: Cindezela isikhathi sokulima ukuze ubone konke ngesilimo esisodwa ensimini eyodwa.
guide.start.5: Sebenzisa ibhokisi lolimi phezulu kunoma yiliphi ikhasi ukuze utshintshe ulimi. Uhlelo luyakukhumbula ukukhetha kwakho ngesikhathi esizayo.
guide.home.title: Ikhasi lokuqala
guide.home.p1: Ikhasi lokuqala litshengisa imephu yesigaba enemibala etshengisa ukutshisa umhlabathi osukutholile ngalesi isikhathi sokulima. Litshengisa lomumo womkhathi khathesi lowezinsuku ezilandelayo, umhlabathi wepulazi lokubonisa, izilokazane ezisanda kubonwa eduze, lesilinganiso sezivuno zesigaba. Akudingeki ungene ukuze ukubone.
guide.dashboard.title: Ikhasi elikhulu lepulazi
guide.dashboard.intro: Ikhasi elikhulu litshengisa ipulazi elilodwa. Lezi yizingxenye zalo kusukela phezulu kusiya phansi. Ibhokisi lepulazi eliphezulu likuvumela ukuthi uye kwelinye ipulazi.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Isifinqo sepulazi
guide.dashboard.summary: Inani lamasimu lamahekitha epulazi, izikhathi zokulima eziqhubekayo lezilimo esezivuthiwe.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Okudinga ukunakwa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Izixwayiso ezimfitshane, njengesithwathwa kumbe ukutshisa okuzayo, isilimo esesivuthiwe, isikhathi sokulima esingaqalisanga ngesikhathi kumbe izilokazane ezibonwe eduze lensimu. Isixwayiso ngasinye sitsho ukuthi sibangelwe yini.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Umumo wepulazi
guide.dashboard.conditions: Umumo womkhathi wanamuhla, isibikezelo, umhlabathi lezilokazane eziseduze laleli pulazi.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Ukuqhubeka kwesikhathi sokulima
guide.dashboard.progress: Ikhadi lesilimo ngasinye elitshengisa ukuthi sesiqoqe ukutshisa okunganani. Ungaqathanisa amasimu eceleni kwelinye njalo udawunilode uluhlu njengefayela lespredishithi (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Amasimu
guide.dashboard.fields: Wonke amasimu epulazini, ubukhulu bawo, umhlabathi wawo lezilimo zawo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Dinga amarekhodi
guide.dashboard.search: Bhala okufunayo ngamazwi ajayelekileyo, njengentwala kukolweni. Kuthola okubonwe ensimini lemisebenzi eyenziweyo etsho into efananayo, lanxa kubhalwe ngamanye amazwi.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Izeluleko
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Umsebenzi ophakanyiselwe insimu, njengokufafaza kumbe ukufaka umvundiso. Ungavuma kumbe wale ngakunye, ubusuphawula ukuthi sekwenziwe nxa umsebenzi usuphelile.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Okwenzakale muva
guide.dashboard.activity: Uluhlu lwezinsuku isilimo ngasinye esadlulela ngazo esigabeni esitsha.
guide.season.title: Ikhasi lesikhathi sokulima
guide.season.intro: Isikhathi sokulima yisilimo esisodwa ensimini eyodwa ngomnyaka owodwa. Ikhasi laso lilakho konke okuphathelane laso.
guide.season.top.label: Phezulu kwekhasi
guide.season.top: Isilimo, insimu, usuku lokuhlanyela, isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelweyo lesivuno nxa ususifakile.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Ukulandelana kwezigaba
guide.season.pipeline: Izigaba eziyisithupha, kuphawulwe esikhona khathesi. Cindezela u-Reconcile now ukuze uhlole khonapho ukuthi isilimo kufanele sidlulele phambili yini.
guide.season.readiness.label: Okudingekayo ukuze kuqhubekwe
guide.season.readiness: Uluhlu lwalokho uhlelo olukudingayo lungakahambisi isilimo phambili, njengosuku lokuhlanyela ledatha yomkhathi eyaneleyo. Into ngayinye ithi Pass, Warning kumbe Blocked. Nxa ithi Blocked, iyakutshela okusilelayo.
guide.season.evidence.label: Ubufakazi
guide.season.evidence: Amarekhodi asetshenziswe luhlelo ukwenza izinqumo ukuze uwahlole.
guide.season.propose.label: Phakamisa iseluleko
guide.season.propose: Phakamisa umsebenzi wale insimu, ubufakazi besikhathi sokulima buhambisane lawo. Uhlala uluhlaka kuze kube lomuntu owuvumayo ekhasini elikhulu.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Ishathi yamayunithi okutshisa aqoqekayo selokhu kwahlanyelwa, ilomugqa wenani elidingwa yisilimo.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Kungenzakalani nxa...?
guide.season.whatIf: Zama usuku lokuhlanyela olungaphambili kumbe olusemuva, loba isikhathi sokulima esitshisa kumbe esiqanda kakhulu, ubone ukuthi amayunithi okutshisa angatshintsha njani. Akulalutho olugcinwayo.
guide.season.summary.label: Isifinqo sesikhathi sokulima
guide.season.summary: Isifinqo esifitshane samarekhodi esikhathi sokulima esibhalwe yi-AI. Sisebenzise njengomsizi, uhlole amarekhodi nxa kukhona okungakhanyi kuhle.
guide.season.notes.label: Imibhalo yesikhathi sokulima
guide.season.notes: Imibhalo yesikhathi sokulima elamalanga. Ungayengeza, uyitshintshe kumbe uyisuse, njalo ubuyise inguqulo endala.
guide.season.files.label: Umfanekiso wensimu lombiko wokuhlolwa komhlabathi
guide.season.files: Layisha umfanekiso wensimu lombiko we-PDF wokuhlolwa komhlabathi ovela elebhu.
guide.season.log.label: Irekhodi lensimu
guide.season.log: Okubone ensimini lokwenze kuyo, njengokufafaza, umuthi owusebenzisileyo lesilinganiso sawo.
guide.season.history.label: Imbali yezinguquko
guide.season.history: Lonke utshintsho olugcinwe kulesi isikhathi sokulima losuku lwalo.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Isilinganiso sesigaba
guide.season.benchmark: Isilinganiso sesivuno sesigaba esivela kumanani omphakathi. Ngesokuqathanisa kuphela, akusiso isivuno sensimu yakho.
guide.season.pests.label: Izilokazane ezibonwe esigabeni
guide.season.pests: Izilokazane ezibikwe eduze lensimu ku-GBIF, idathabheyisi yomphakathi yezinto ezibonwe ngabantu. Cindezela u-Fetch sightings ukuze uthole ezakamuva.
guide.sources.title: Avela ngaphi amanani
guide.sources.weather: Umumo womkhathi uvela ku-Open-Meteo, owanamuhla, isibikezelo lowezinsuku ezedlulileyo.
guide.sources.soil: Umhlabathi uvela ku-SoilGrids, imephu yomhlabathi womhlaba wonke.
guide.sources.pests: Izilokazane ezibonwe ngabantu zivela ku-GBIF, idathabheyisi yomphakathi yezinto ezibonwe ngabantu.
guide.sources.yields: Izivuno zesigaba zivela ku-USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa leWorld Bank.
guide.sources.you: Konke okunye, njengemibhalo, imisebenzi eyenziweyo lezivuno zakho, kufakwe nguwe kumbe liqembu lakho.
guide.limits.title: Lokho engeke ikwenze
guide.limits.model: Amayunithi okutshisa adingwa yisilimo ngasinye yizilinganiso zethu njalo awakahlolwa ensimini. Wasebenzise njengomhlahlandlela, kodwa wethembe okubona ensimini yakho.
guide.limits.maturity: Ukuvuthwa ngokutshisa kutsho ukuthi umumo womkhathi uthi isilimo sesilungele ukuvunwa. Nguwe kuphela owaziyo ukuthi sesilungele sibili.
guide.limits.translation: Ukuhumutsha lokhu kwenziwe yi-AI. Kumele kube lula ukukulandela, kodwa akula muntu okhuluma ulimi lolu owahlole zonke indimi.
guide.limits.demo: Idemo ivulekele wonke umuntu, ngakho ungafaki ulwazi oluyimfihlo.
dashboard.picker.heading: Ufuna ukuya kuliphi ipulazi lamuhla?
dashboard.picker.intro: Khetha ipulazi ukuze uvule imininingwane yalo.
dashboard.picker.empty: Akukabi lamapulazi. Sebenzisa i-seed script ukuze uwafake.
dashboard.summary.title: Isifinqo sepulazi
dashboard.alerts.title: Okudinga ukunanzwa
dashboard.conditions.title: Isimo sepulazi
dashboard.conditions.noCoordinates: Faka indawo yepulazi ukuze ubone umumo womkhathi, umhlabathi lezilokazane.
